purpose: Give the release-pair submission delta a clear promote/rewrite/hold decision path after deployment traffic lands.
guardrail: Do not promote Current Market or Home Project only because they are staged. Require Search Console visibility plus Supabase behavior before expanding keywords.

globalCompareActions.reading: GLB proof is the strongest current engagement signal.
globalCompareActions.action: Promote 3D Model View proof in watch pages, blog intros, and category snippets before adding more generic copy.

globalCompareActions.reading: Search is not yet proving user intent.
globalCompareActions.action: Move category lane dropdown and quick panel wording toward obvious search intent: next episode stays in lane, search creates radar, market clicks route to market view.

globalCompareActions.reading: The live observatory now exposes queue, proof, analyzer, timing, and market cadence in the category-locked panel.
globalCompareActions.action: Use the cadence rail to measure whether visitors understand the YouTube-style queue, same-category rotation, proof routes, and market/podcast routing before adding more pages.

globalCompareActions.reading: Podcast feature is underused compared with GLB interaction.
globalCompareActions.action: Keep podcast as a click-to-interrupt moment with clearer speaker/source panel and return-to-YouTube state.

globalCompareActions.reading: Market view needs stronger entry from regular feed.
globalCompareActions.action: Keep Market in the regular feed, but make the top 3 bullish/bearish options a compact teaser that routes to the full market view.

globalCompareActions.signal: 54 proof posts / 52 watch URLs / 137 sitemap URLs
globalCompareActions.reading: Blog proof exists, but needs more movement from live experience to proof routes.
globalCompareActions.action: Interlink standby, insights, blog, watch proof, and category pages so the crawler sees a complete DigitalHut observatory evidence loop.

globalCompareActions.signal: Scenario input: exotic environments cool monthly while messy visual content, filters, reels, and quick transformations need more first-page capture.
globalCompareActions.reading: The map should not delete exotic environments; it should move them into second-place backlink defense while promoting broader visual-content searches into the featured lane.
globalCompareActions.action: Use FireCuda overseer groups to separate main-featured visual content, second-place exotic environment backlinks, developer/research trust, and market/local business conversion lanes.

globalCompareActions.signal: Scenario input: a fresh viral video needs DigitalHut ready across analytics, GLB proof, podcast/source moment, backlinks, and crawlable proof without changing the live UI.
globalCompareActions.reading: The front-end stays locked. Backend SEO and analytics should be ready to classify the topic, capture source behavior, connect GLB/podcast proof, and decide whether the viral lane deserves a public proof route.
globalCompareActions.action: Stage the viral first-source keyword packet, Supabase event names, source/backlink targets, Google media checks, and compare/refine gate before any visible product change.

globalCompareActions.reading: Local code is ahead of production until the stable batch deploys.
globalCompareActions.action: Deploy only after the GLB collapse, podcast click, standby proof page, and refinement board are in the same stable build.
